data.one_liner: A DNS resolver for Dart and Flutter supporting DoH and traditional UDP/TCP lookups.
data.what_it_does: Performs DNS-over-HTTPS and traditional UDP/TCP lookups with system-aware DNS discovery across Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, and other platforms. It supports querying A, AAAA, CNAME, SRV, and TXT records with built-in public resolver fallbacks and caching.
use_when: You need to perform custom DNS queries (A, AAAA, TXT, SRV, CNAME) inside a Flutter or Dart application.
You want to query DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) using providers like Cloudflare or Google.
You need native system DNS discovery on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You need custom DoH resolvers that strictly require HTTP/2 (such as Quad9 or Mullvad), as this library uses HTTP/1.1.
You are running on the Web where browsers restrict raw DNS queries.
strengths: Supports both DoH and traditional UDP/TCP DNS lookups.
Native system DNS detection across Android, iOS, macOS, and Linux.
Includes public resolver fallbacks and TTL-based SRV caching.
weaknesses: Custom DoH resolvers must accept HTTP/1.1 because HTTP/2 is not supported.
Not supported on the Web due to browser limitations on raw DNS queries.
data.setup_notes: Android requires ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permission for system DNS detection.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard HTTP client functionality without low-level DNS resolution controls.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust HTTP client featuring interceptors, global configuration, and form data support.
